turns.question: Our project concerns deploying authenticated workers with scoped authorization. For the planned deployment, set worker principal to saffron_worker_17. Which value should we use, and which ordering of processing and offset saving gives at-least-once consumption?

asks: project worker principal

turns.answer: The project worker principal is saffron_worker_17. Read, process, then save the position gives at-least-once consumption.
key_facts: The project worker principal is saffron_worker_17.
Read, process, then save the position gives at-least-once consumption.
